name: Palms — curated world set
status: 43 species, curated (Kew accepts ~2,600 palms; these are the regional dominants and icons)
notes: The recognisable palms of every palm region: tropical coasts, oases, African savanna and swamp, Asian monsoon plains and rainforest, Australia and NZ, Andean cloud forest (the wax palm as an emergent), Amazon floodplain and swamp, the SE US, desert canyon oases, the Mediterranean, and cold-hardy hill palms. Tiers: emergent for the wax palm, canopy for trunked palms, shrub for trunkless and clumping palms, epiphyte for rattan (climbing). The 'palm' shape exists; Phase 6 should give it fan vs feather crowns, a clustering form, and the doum fork.

emergent.name: Andean wax palm
emergent.source: Palm of Colombian and Peruvian Andes cloud forest; height 40-60 m. Tallest palm on Earth; waxy white trunk above the cloud forest. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Coconut palm
canopy.source: Palm of tropical coasts worldwide; height 15-30 m. Leaning trunk, feather crown; sea-dispersed nuts. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Date palm
canopy.source: Palm of Sahara, Arabia, Mesopotamia oases; height 15-25 m. Oasis palm; suckers from the base. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Doum palm
canopy.source: Palm of Sahel and Nile valley; height 8-15 m. The only branching palm; forked trunk. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Oil palm
canopy.source: Palm of West and Central African rainforest; height 15-20 m. Stout trunk, huge fronds; secondary forest and river margins. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Raffia palm
canopy.source: Palm of African swamp forest; height 8-12 m. Longest leaves of any plant, to 20 m. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: African fan palm
canopy.source: Palm of African savanna; height 15-25 m. Swollen trunk, fan leaves; savanna sentinel. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Palmyra palm
canopy.source: Palm of India, SE Asia dry plains; height 20-30 m. Fan palm of the monsoon plains. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Sago palm
canopy.source: Palm of New Guinea and Malesian swamps; height 10-15 m. Swamp palm; staple starch of New Guinea. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Betel palm
canopy.source: Palm of SE Asian villages and forest edge; height 15-25 m. Slender ringed trunk. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Fishtail palm
canopy.source: Palm of India and Sri Lanka forests; height 12-20 m. Bipinnate fishtail leaves; flowers once and dies. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Talipot palm
canopy.source: Palm of Sri Lanka and Malabar; height 20-25 m. Largest inflorescence of any plant; blooms once at 30-80 years then dies. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Chinese fan palm
canopy.source: Palm of S China, Ryukyus; height 9-15 m.  Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Cabbage-tree palm
canopy.source: Palm of E Australian wet forest and swamp; height 15-25 m.  Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Red cabbage palm
canopy.source: Palm of Palm Valley, central Australia; height 15-25 m. Relict palm of a desert gorge. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Nikau palm
canopy.source: Palm of New Zealand lowland forest; height 10-15 m. Southernmost palm; shuttlecock crown. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Chilean wine palm
canopy.source: Palm of central Chile; height 15-25 m. Elephant-leg trunk; the thickest palm. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Açaí palm
canopy.source: Palm of Amazon floodplain; height 15-25 m. Clustering, slender; floodplain groves. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Moriche palm
canopy.source: Palm of Amazon and Orinoco swamps; height 20-35 m. Fan palm of the swamps; buriti. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Babassu
canopy.source: Palm of Brazilian cerrado-forest edge; height 15-25 m. Huge erect fronds; forms pure stands after clearing. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Carnauba
canopy.source: Palm of NE Brazilian caatinga and floodplains; height 10-15 m. Waxy fan palm of the dry north-east. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Royal palm
canopy.source: Palm of Cuba and Caribbean lowlands; height 20-30 m. Smooth grey column, bright crownshaft. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Sabal palmetto
canopy.source: Palm of SE US coastal plain; height 10-20 m. Cabbage palm of the barrier islands and hammocks. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: California fan palm
canopy.source: Palm of Sonoran/Colorado desert oases and canyons; height 15-20 m. Petticoat of dead fronds; spring-fed canyon groves. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Mexican fan palm
canopy.source: Palm of Baja and Sonora canyons; height 20-30 m. Thinner and taller than filifera. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Guadalupe palm
canopy.source: Palm of Guadalupe Island; Baja; height 8-12 m.  Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Mexican blue palm
canopy.source: Palm of Baja California canyons; height 8-15 m. Silver-blue fans; desert canyons. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Cretan date palm
canopy.source: Palm of Crete and SW Turkey beaches; height 10-15 m.  Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Windmill palm
canopy.source: Palm of central China hills; height 8-12 m. Fibrous trunk, cold-hardy; snow-tolerant. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Wild date palm
canopy.source: Palm of Indian plains; height 10-15 m. Tapped for toddy; dry monsoon plains. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Senegal date palm
canopy.source: Palm of African riverbanks and swamp edges; height 6-10 m. Clustering, leaning trunks over water. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Buriti-do-brejo
canopy.source: Palm of Amazon and cerrado streams; height 8-15 m. Spiny clustering fan palm. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Foxtail palm
canopy.source: Palm of Cape Melville, Queensland; height 10-15 m. Boulder-field palm with plume fronds. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Peach palm
canopy.source: Palm of Amazon and Central American lowlands; height 15-20 m. Spiny ringed trunks in clusters; cultivated by forest peoples. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Walking palm
canopy.source: Palm of Amazon and Central American rainforest; height 15-25 m. Stilt roots; the tripod palm. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

canopy.name: Coco de mer
canopy.source: Palm of Praslin, Seychelles; height 25-34 m. Largest seed in the plant kingdom; mythic-rare island palm. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

shrub.name: Nipa palm
shrub.source: Palm of Indo-Pacific estuaries; height 5-9 m. Trunkless mangrove palm; fronds rise from the mud. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

shrub.name: Saw palmetto
shrub.source: Palm of SE US pine flatwoods; height 1-3 m. Creeping trunk; dense understory fans. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

shrub.name: Needle palm
shrub.source: Palm of SE US ravines; height 1-2 m. Hardiest palm on Earth; survives -20 C. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

shrub.name: Dwarf palmetto
shrub.source: Palm of SE US floodplains; height 1-2 m. Trunkless fan palm of wet woods. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

shrub.name: Mediterranean fan palm
shrub.source: Palm of Mediterranean scrub, Morocco to Spain; height 1-4 m. The only native European palm; clumping fans. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

shrub.name: Bottle palm
shrub.source: Palm of Round Island, Mauritius; height 3-6 m. Swollen bottle trunk; island rarity. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.

epiphyte.name: Rattan
epiphyte.source: Palm of Malesian rainforest; height 30-100 m. Climbing palm; hooked whips reach the canopy. Standard floras and Kew POWO for the name.
